context: Evaluates whether the model correctly uses ClipboardGetText to read clipboard content and ClipboardSetText to write it. The key challenge is knowing both function names, that ClipboardGetText takes no arguments, and that ClipboardSetText accepts the text string and returns a Promise<boolean>.

checklist.name: ClipboardGetText used
checklist.description: ClipboardGetText from @wailsapp/runtime is called (with no arguments) inside readText

checklist.name: readText Promise forwarded
checklist.description: readText returns the Promise<string> from ClipboardGetText without re-wrapping

checklist.name: ClipboardSetText used
checklist.description: ClipboardSetText from @wailsapp/runtime is called inside writeText with the text argument

checklist.name: writeText Promise forwarded
checklist.description: writeText returns the Promise<boolean> from ClipboardSetText without re-wrapping
